'''Maer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Maer's ambulatory was in the [[Black Sun territory]] and he witnessed many atrocities while stationed there. One of Maer's patients, [[Curt Willham]], told the doctor that [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] had been smuggling contraband offworld inside people's bodies, especially [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifacts]] found by the [[Justicars' Brigade]]. Fortunately, Maer met a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] in the [[Silent Sun cantina]] who wanted to help him to save the unlucky [[Smuggler/Legends|Black Sun smugglers]]. With the Consular's help, Maer saved the lives of the smugglers and blew a critical hit to the smuggling ring.
